title: Prove an all-width tensor-frame reduction under fixed boundaries (no new κ)
body:
Coupling copies does not improve the normalized recursive rank moment of the fixed scalar contact-graph model when all public and productive boundary spaces are fixed and repeated. The proof allows arbitrary internal Clifford frames and every positive tensor width. **No new kappa or P104 optimum is claimed.**

The new step decomposes projected spaces along one coordinate flag, then uses concavity to choose one copy for the whole graph. Fixed target credits survive that reduction. The Clifford projection inequality is prior work by Cinna Davis in [PR5140](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5140), at `1d1b593168a36ee524300752a5e33f6cd7a08314`; this package credits it.

[Proof and package](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/tree/343232cdf5273d1f77569de390f0977b46916644/research/tensor-frame-reduction) · [Exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343232cdf5273d1f77569de390f0977b46916644/research/tensor-frame-reduction/RESULT.json) · [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5600#discussioncomment-19209322)

Validation:

- Registered Python 3.12 replay passes in normal and optimized modes: 9,259 ordered subspace pairs, 25,344 composed native-rank cases, 16,426 exact concave hinge checks, 675 whole-graph fixtures and seven hypothesis controls. Native pairs are exhaustive through dimension three; dimension four uses three stated offsets.
- Binary elimination is checked against explicit vector sets. A changed receipt is rejected under optimized Python. The written dimension argument, rather than finite extrapolation, gives the all-width result.
- At proof commit `dfa1d461ec80d8a11644455930a69a60ab735666`, committed bytes/modes and official export/input coverage pass. The optimized read-only Git-free replay passes in 1.0396 seconds with empty PATH; all nine exported files keep their bytes and modes. Final head adds only this validation record and passes committed-byte/mode checks.
- Direct base ancestry passes. Full source-history preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout. Hosted CI and independent scientific review remain pending.

Variable productive boundaries, changed scalar words, fixed internal native-operator equations, restricted adapters and nonconcave tariffs remain outside the theorem. No native-phase, complete caller, precision, compiler, BIT or outer replay was run. Discovery optimizer results are not premises. The donor's requested major breakthrough and at least 1% fully charged kappa gain remain unmet.

Base: canonical main `3f0152a32eeebac0df11946dbd50cabe5a7f7839`, priority revision8. PR6167 at `564a076b113621a93edc4e39968ee4e4a8c9caf0` remains the complete open comparison. PR6168's caller/query investigation and PR6170's toolkit are separate. The selected frontier is unchanged.

New proof step and replay: Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Cinna Davis / 1337isnot1337 retains PR5140 and its Matarener, Dugongue and Cao Yifan lineage. icekylinx retains the arbitrary-subspace frame construction. All P104/native/helper/caller/compiler source credit remains. No predecessor code is copied. Standard subspace and concavity facts are used; no literature-priority claim. Apache-2.0.
